message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of Tempo magazine. A person with black hair stands on the left, facing right. They wear a white shirt, dark pants, a gold-colored scarf, and black shoes. A red apple sits on top of their head. They stand on a grey concrete dock. In the background is a large black cargo ship with grey containers, positioned on blue water. Behind the ship are several large yellow gantry cranes. A few industrial structures are visible in the far background under a clear light-blue sky.

At the top, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered. Above it, text reads "DJAROT SOAL AHOK DAN GUBERNUR BARU / JALUR TELEGRAM TERORIS INDONESIA". Below the main title, "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" is printed. Large black text at the bottom right says "AWAS RINI!" followed by a block of Indonesian text. The bottom right corner contains a barcode, the date "10-16 JULI 2017," a price, and other publication details. The left edge of the image has a solid red border.
